images.filename: HMS 'Resistance', sunk at Holyhead on February 9, the Vessel after her last day in use as a target - ILN 1899.jpg
images.caption:
H.M.S. Resistance, sunk at Holyhead on 9 February, the Vessel after her Last Day in use as a Target by English Photographer. Illustration for The Illustrated London News, 18 February 1899. Volume: 114 , Issue: 3122.

Same photograph also published with a different caption as: The Fate of one of the first of our Ironclads. An illustration for The Graphic, 18 February 1899.

Photograph taken 9 February 1899 at Rotten Row, Portsmouth. Resistance side by side with the Hector.
